EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE VAVUNIYA URBANCOUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Vavuniya Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Eelam People’s Democratic Party, the recognized political party to whichBalasingam Prasanna the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, todecide upon returned member of Eelam People’s Democratic Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualifiedunder section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within aperiod of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Wijayakumar Joel Niroshan to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Malawenna Godage Lalith Ananda, Returning Officer of the Vavuniya Urban Council,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatWijayakumar Joel Niroshan was selected as the member of the Vavuniya Municipal Council.
M. G. LALITH ANANDA,Returning Officer,Vavuniya Urban Council.District Election Office,Vavuniya,02nd December, 2019.
